input: Explore glassblowing workshops in the city

gold.taskTitle: Find and Explore Glassblowing Workshops in Your City
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to discover and evaluate glassblowing workshops available in their city, likely to attend or enroll in one.

questions.title: Which city are you looking for workshops in?
questions.description: Identify the specific city or metro area to search within.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or have prior glassblowing experience?
questions.description: Determine the user's skill level to filter beginner, intermediate, or advanced workshops.

questions.title: Do you want a one-time class or a multi-session course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single drop-in experience or an ongoing structured program.

questions.title: What is your budget per session or per course?
questions.description: Establish a price range to narrow down affordable workshop options.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred date or timeframe to attend?
questions.description: Understand scheduling constraints such as weekends only, evenings, or a specific month.

questions.title: Is this for yourself, a group, or a special occasion?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a solo activity, a group outing, or an event like a birthday or team-building session.

questions.title: Do you want to keep a finished piece from the workshop?
questions.description: Find out if the ability to take home a created glass piece is a priority when evaluating workshops.
